organization_telephone_number_id.title: Organization Telephone Number Id
organization_telephone_number_id.description: Organization-owned telephone number identifier. Use the `id` returned by `GET /v3/organization-telephone-numbers`, not the phone number string.

uan_telephone_id.title: Uan Telephone Id
uan_telephone_id.description: UAN telephone identifier. Use the `id` returned by `GET /v3/telephone-numbers/uan`, not the phone number string.

telephone_presentation_number_id.title: Telephone Presentation Number Id
telephone_presentation_number_id.description: Telephone presentation number identifier. Use the `id` returned by `GET /v3/telephone-presentation-numbers` or `POST /v3/telephone-presentation-numbers`.
